description: Search the public U.S. Department of Labor Form 5500-SF filings that power the ClearMind 401(k) Scorecard. Covers 401(k) plans in all 50 states and DC that file the 5500-SF (usually under 100 participants); larger plans file the full Form 5500 and are not included, and a miss returns an empty list with a link to request a hand-built Scorecard. Search by name needs the two-letter state the company files from; an EIN works in any state. Returns up to 5 plans with sponsor, city, state, plan year, participant count, and plan_id. No auth. Step 1 of 2: pass the plan_id to get_401k_scorecard_preview for the score.

query.description: Company or plan name (e.g. 'Acme Tool'), a 9-digit EIN, or a 12-digit EIN plus plan number. Dashes and spaces are ignored.

state.description: Two-letter state (or DC) of the company's address on its filing, e.g. OH or TX. Required to search by name; ignored for an EIN.

name: find_401k_plan
title: Find a company's 401(k) plan
